plan: Would install odbcinst, unixodbc and unzip if the exact package is absent
Would retrieve secret reference JBLAB-token through azure-key-vault
Would create /opt/jitterbit/Resources/register.json if credentials are absent
Would restart Jitterbit once and monitor /opt/jitterbit/log/jitterbit-agent.log
Would retrieve registration field cloud_url from JBLAB-cloudUrl
Would retrieve registration field agent_group_id from JBLAB-agentGroupId
Would retrieve registration field agent_name_prefix from JBLAB-agentNamePrefix
Would retrieve registration field deregister_on_drainstop from JBLAB-deregisterAgentOnDrainstop
Would retrieve registration field retry_count from JBLAB-retryCount
Would retrieve registration field retry_interval_seconds from JBLAB-retryIntervalSeconds
